Answer: C
Reason: The frontal chest X-ray (Figure 1a) shows blue arrows pointing to two distinct nodular opacities: one in the right mid-lung zone silhouetting the right heart border (consistent with right middle lobe location) and another retrocardiac opacity on the left. This specific finding of discrete nodules, often associated with air trapping or mosaic attenuation on CT, is characteristic of Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia (DIPNECH).
